plan.title: Conversation issue links: handle issues the dashboard snapshot does not hold (CodeRabbit finding on merged #4716)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Five small frontend items; no server change.

narratives.Problem: TranscriptIssueLink (PAN-4714) intercepts plain clicks on resolvable issue links in conversations and opens the issue drawer without checking the dashboard snapshot. CodeRabbit flagged that an issue absent from the snapshot opens a drawer titled 'Issue details' with no record, and that the drawer's tracker-button fallback only covers the hardcoded PAN/KRUX prefixes. Planning verified live: an aged-out closed issue (PAN-3659) hydrates through the existing PAN-3659 backfill (title and tracker button appear), but a cycle-filtered issue (MIN-658, Linear Backlog) never hydrates and its drawer has no title and no tracker button, a dead end.
narratives.Proposal: Follow the issue's rule: the drawer already has an on-demand issue-fetch path (subscribeIssueEvents -> backfillIssue -> issues.delta), so keep intercepting. Close the dead end for issues that path cannot load: openIssue gains an optional third argument trackerUrl stored on the drawer slice (not in the URL, preserved across tab switches, cleared on close/URL sync), TranscriptIssueLink passes its href, and the drawer header's tracker button falls back to drawer.trackerUrl when the issue row is absent. Add component tests for the absent-issue click, the tracker fallback, and client-side hydration via issues.delta; document the behaviour; attach a closed-issue-link screenshot to the PR; reply to the CodeRabbit thread on #4716.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the server snapshot, the current-cycle filter, IssueDataService.backfillIssue, or resolveMissingIssue (including its failure memo).
- No new HTTP route, RPC method, or contract type.
- No gating of the click on snapshot presence (CodeRabbit's literal suggestion is not adopted; see autoDecisions).
- No change to what the drawer body shows for done or backfilled issues (Plan (Auto) controls, queued review specialists, Start work on a closed issue).
- No change to the 'Issue details' placeholder text.
- No change to PR links, links outside a conversation, modified/middle clicks, or hosts where IssueDrawerAvailableContext is false.
- No change to trackerIssueUrl's hardcoded prefix table in lib/issueLinks.ts.
- trackerUrl is never written to the page URL.

autoDecisions.summary: Chose on-demand load (keep intercepting) over falling through to the tracker for issues absent from the snapshot.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says to pick on-demand load if the drawer already has an issue-fetch path. It does: the PAN-3659 backfill fired by subscribeIssueEvents. A live Playwright probe showed it loads PAN-3659 (aged-out closed, the common absent case) with title and tracker button within seconds. Falling through would regress PAN-4714 for that common case.

autoDecisions.summary: Covered the residual class (cycle-filtered and unresolvable issues) with a tracker-URL fallback carried from the clicked link, not by widening the snapshot.
autoDecisions.rationale: The probe showed MIN-658 (Linear Backlog) never hydrates and its drawer has no tracker button. About 14 frontend views read issuesRaw, so pushing backlog/canceled rows into the shared snapshot would change the kanban, Command Deck, God View and others. The click decision must stay synchronous (a deferred window.open is popup-blocked), so a server probe before deciding is not viable. Passing the link's href gives every such drawer a working exit for every registered repository, which also answers CodeRabbit's second point.

autoDecisions.summary: Repro IDs: PAN-3659 for aged-out closed, MIN-658 for cycle-filtered; PAN-4299 (the issue's example) is in the snapshot and is not a repro.
autoDecisions.rationale: GET /api/issues on 2026-11-01 listed PAN-4299 but not PAN-3659 or MIN-658; MIN-658 appears only with ?cycle=all.

autoDecisions.summary: Screenshots are committed under docs/screenshots/pan-4717/ and embedded in the PR via a blob ?raw=true URL.
autoDecisions.rationale: Repo precedent (docs/screenshots/pan-4626/, docs/screenshots/pan-4523/); gh cannot upload images to a PR body.

items.title: Drawer slice carries trackerUrl; header tracker button falls back to it

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/store.ts: add optional `trackerUrl?: string` to `DrawerState` (line 38) with a PAN-4717 comment; change the interface to `openIssue(issueId: string, tab?: string, trackerUrl?: string): void` (line 67); in the `openIssue` implementation (line 213) build `trackerUrl ? { issueId, tab, trackerUrl } : { issueId, tab }` (only add the key when present so the 22 existing `toEqual({ issueId, tab })` assertions keep passing); in `setDrawerTab` (line 249) carry `state.drawer.trackerUrl` into the new drawer when present. Leave closeIssue, openIssueFromRoute, syncDrawerFromUrl and replaceDrawerUrl unchanged (trackerUrl never enters the URL). In src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/drawer/IssueDrawer.tsx line 110 change to `trackerIssueUrl(drawer.issueId ?? '', issue?.url ?? drawer.trackerUrl)`. Create IssueDrawer.tracker-fallback.test.tsx by copying the harness from IssueDrawer.test.tsx (hoisted wsTransportMock, vi.mock of ../../lib/wsTransport, mockFetch, beforeEach store reset, resetDrawerIssueSubscriptionForTest, renderDrawer) and add the five cases listed in the PRD. ORDER MATTERS: IssueDrawer calls syncDrawerFromUrl() on mount, which rebuilds the drawer from the URL and drops trackerUrl, so every case calls renderDrawer() FIRST and then act(() => openIssue(..., trackerUrl)); add a separate case asserting syncDrawerFromUrl() clears trackerUrl. Add `src/components/drawer/IssueDrawer.tracker-fallback.test.tsx` to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt in sorted position.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Test only, no source change. Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/drawer/useDrawerData.absent-issue.test.tsx: renderHook(() => useIssueData('PAN-3659')) inside a QueryClientProvider (retry off); vi.mock '../../lib/wsTransport' with getTransport returning { subscribe: vi.fn(() => vi.fn()), request: vi.fn() } (hoisted, like IssueDrawer.test.tsx); stub fetch to return Response.json({ tasks: [] }) for URLs containing '/tasks' and Response.json({}) otherwise; call resetDrawerIssueSubscriptionForTest() in beforeEach; seed issuesRaw with one unrelated row (PAN-1). Apply the backfill row with useDashboardStore.getState().applyEvent({ type: 'issues.delta', sequence: 2, timestamp: '2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z', payload: { length: 2, changes: [{ index: 1, issue: <PAN-3659 row with identifier, id, title 'Backfilled title', url 'https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/issues/3659', status 'Done', labels []> }] } } as DomainEvent) inside act(). applyEvent takes a single DomainEvent (store.ts line 56). This mirrors what the server emits after backfillIssue (issues.delta arrives on the global stream; ws-rpc.ts filters it out of issue-scoped streams). Add the file to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt in sorted position.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. Implementation checkpoint. (1) cd packages/contracts && npm run build; start the workspace frontend in the background: cd src/dashboard/frontend && npx vite --port 3417 --strictPort (proxies /api and /ws to the live dashboard at 127.0.0.1:3011; choose another free port if taken). (2) Pick a CLOSED overdeck issue absent from `curl -s http://localhost:3011/api/issues` (confirm closed with gh issue view <n> --repo eltmon/overdeck --json state) and find a conversation transcript linking it with `grep -l 'github.com/eltmon/overdeck/issues/<n>' ~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl` (read-only; never modify JSONL); map the session to /conv/<id> via pan conversations list/show. If none links an absent closed issue, use a conversation linking any closed issue (e.g. PAN-4299) and say which case was shown. (3) In an isolated Playwright browser (chromium.launch() + newContext(); never a shared profile or another agent's session) open http://localhost:3417/conv/<id>, click a[data-issue-id="<ID>"], wait for [data-testid=issue-drawer], wait up to 10 s for the header h2 to stop reading 'Issue details', screenshot. (4) Save to docs/screenshots/pan-4717/closed-issue-link-drawer.png, commit, embed in the PR description with a https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/blob/feature/pan-4717/docs/screenshots/pan-4717/closed-issue-link-drawer.png?raw=true image link plus the commands used; stop Vite. The screenshot is MANDATORY: this item is not complete until the PNG is committed and embedded in the PR description. If Vite or Playwright cannot run, try another free port and VITE_PROXY_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:3011; if it still fails, leave this item pending (do not mark it done), record the exact error in the PR description, and run pan tell flywheel-orchestrator "work PAN-4717: screenshot capture blocked - <error>". (5) Reply in the existing thread: gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/pulls/4716/comments/4435754182/replies -f body="Addressed in PAN-4717 (https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/issues/4717). ..." with one paragraph explaining: the drawer's on-demand path (PAN-3659 backfill) loads aged-out closed issues so the link keeps intercepting; for issues it cannot load (cycle-filtered backlog/canceled, unresolvable) the link passes its href and the drawer's tracker button falls back to it, covering every registered repository; name the three test files and the fix commit SHA. Confirm with the gh --jq query in verify_commands and add the reply URL to the PR description. Post nothing else externally.
